items.question: How should the half-measure be reduced from one's own measure when making the staff?
premises: Own measure is the starting standard.
items.inference: The staff measure is derived by reducing half a measure from one's own measure.
uncertainties: Exact referent of 'own measure' in the ritual context is not specified.
items.plain_english: Make it fittingly, reduced by half a measure from one's own measure.
